description: This file defines the ProjectActivityDecorator class, which is part of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class acts as a decorator for ProjectActivity entities, providing methods to set associated Project entities by ID and utilizing traits for ORM operations.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for ProjectActivity entities, facilitating the association of projects via project IDs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a ProjectActivity instance.

methods.name: setProjectById
methods.description: Associates a Project entity with the wrapped ProjectActivity using a Project ID.
